`createUser` now accepts an optional `nickname`, and `getUser` returns it (`null` when not set). `npm test` passes: 3 of 3, including `test/users-nickname.test.js`.

- **`src/api/users.js`:** `createUser` stores the nickname, and `getUser` returns it.
- **`migrations/003_add_nickname.js` (new):** adds the `nickname` column to `users`. I added a new migration instead of editing 001 or 002, since those are already applied in production. `migrations/README.md` says that directory is owned by the DBA team, so they may want to review 003.
